title: ScientificEvidence
description: A piece of evidence collected during a SciLoop research campaign with full provenance

campaign_id.description: ID of the parent research campaign

source_type.description: Classification of evidence origin. literature = PubMed/database-backed with citation. computational_prediction = RDKit/scoring output (always label as prediction). model_hypothesis = agent reasoning (lowest weight, never cite as fact).

claim.description: The factual claim this evidence supports or refutes

citation.description: Human-readable citation string (e.g., 'Author et al., Journal, Year')

pmid.description: PubMed ID if source_type is literature

database_id.description: External database identifier (ChEMBL ID, PDB ID, UniProt accession, etc.)

database_name.description: Which external system this evidence came from

query_used.description: The exact query or API call that produced this evidence

api_endpoint.description: The API endpoint that was called

tool_name.description: MCP tool or sandbox script that produced this

raw_response_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the raw API response for integrity verification

uncertainty_notes.description: Explicit uncertainty or caveats about this evidence
